Now the **"nothing to show yet" situations** — these matter because a blank screen is where trust is easily lost. Two to look at:

**1 — A brand-new, empty collection.** Open this fresh-start view: **http://maker:4001/?demo=empty**
You'll see a welcoming prompt instead of a blank page. Paste `https://nasa.gov/webb` and Save — watch the empty message give way to your first bookmark.

**2 — Empty focused views.** Open the normal collection: **http://maker:4001**
Mark **every** "To read" item as finished (use each card's *Mark as finished*), then click the **To read** view — instead of a blank list you'll see *"Nothing left to read — you're all caught up."* (And if nothing is finished, the **Finished** view says *"Nothing marked as finished yet."*)

I chose reassuring, guiding messages for these empty states rather than a bare "no results."

**Do these empty-state messages work for you, or would you word them differently / expect something more (like a suggestion or action) in any of them?**
